items.question: Who is Chat Therapy for?
items.answer: Anyone who wants accessible, anonymous support for stress and emotional well-being. It's not a replacement for professional care but a tool to complement your wellness routine.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Download the app, create an anonymous account, and start your first conversation. No credit card needed for the free plan.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Yes. Conversations are encrypted and we don't sell your data. You can use the app anonymously and delete your data anytime.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: The Free plan is always free. Plus and Premium offer a free trial so you can try advanced features before subscribing.

items.question: How is my data protected?
items.answer: We use encryption and follow strict privacy practices. Your identity and conversations are protected; see our Privacy Policy for details.

items.question: Who can I contact for help?
items.answer: Use the in-app support or the contact form on this site. For crisis support, please reach out to local emergency or mental health services.
